workflows.name: Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) & Consumer Rights Workflow

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "record and downstream sources" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "CDP fulfill within NPC-mandated timelines" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "document the DSAR response, propagate erasure/suppression to downstream systems…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-609 (ensure controlled execution — Customer 360 Consumption, Privacy & Governance Analytics (PA-126.3).)
- operational: SLA tracker; operational: propagation control
Pain Points / Risks: - **Deadline-miss risk**: DSAR not fulfilled within NPC timeline; mitigated by SLA tracker
- **Shadow-copy risk**: Erasure leaves copies in activation/marketing systems; mitigated by propagation control
System Touchpoints: - CDP golden record; loyalty (links to VS-13); ecommerce (links to VS-10); trade (links to VS-16); activation channels (links to W3891); legal hold (links to VS-88); privacy/NPC (links to VS-91)

steps.activity: CDP/Privacy receive and verify DSAR identity (links to VS-91), classify request type, and scope the data to be retrieved from the CDP golden record and downstream sources (POS links to VS-08, ecommerce links to VS-10, loyalty links to VS-13, trade links to VS-16)

CDP fulfill within NPC-mandated timelines: access report (profile, segments, consents, history), rectification (correct/profile update links to W3884), erasure/objection (suppress/delete per policy and legal-hold check links to VS-88/W3013), and portability (export)
CDP/Privacy document the DSAR response, propagate erasure/suppression to downstream systems and activation channels (links to W3891), and maintain the audit trail for NPC (links to VS-91)

workflows.name: Customer Data Privacy, Consent Audit & DPIA

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-register of "register with NPC where required" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-record of "records of processing" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-update of "update the RoPA and notices" (replaces manual Step 3).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Profiling-overreach risk**: ML/profiling beyond consent or lawful basis (links to VS-91); mitigated by DPIA
- **RoPA-staleness risk**: Records of processing out of date; mitigated by annual audit
System Touchpoints: - Privacy/RoPA (links to VS-91); DPIA (links to VS-27.3 W389); legal (links to VS-100); audit (links to VS-21); cross-entity (links to VS-72); audit committee (links to VS-36)
Time Estimate: - ~1–3 weeks per DPIA + ~2–4 weeks annual audit

steps.activity: CDP/Privacy run DPIA for new high-risk CDP processing (profiling/ML, identity resolution links to W3883, vendor data-sharing, biometric-adjacent data — links to VS-91/W389), and register with NPC where required

CDP/Privacy audit consent and processing against the records of processing (RoPA — links to VS-91): verify consent-at-ingestion (links to W3882), consent-at-activation (links to W3891), purpose-limitation, and cross-entity sharing (links to VS-72)
CDP/Privacy remediate findings, update the RoPA and notices (privacy policy links to VS-91/VS-10/VS-75), and brief the privacy committee and Audit Committee (links to VS-21/VS-36)

fields.Participants: CDP Team, Data Governance (links to VS-29/VS-28.2), Privacy (links to VS-91), Legal (links to VS-100/VS-88), Finance/Tax (links to VS-79/VS-17), IT (links to VS-27), Insights (links to VS-28.1)
fields.Trigger: Retention cycle; legal-hold release (links to VS-88)
fields.Volume: ~600K–1M profiles + transaction history (7-yr BIR retention for financial records)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-schedule of "schedule by data class" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-record of "records for BIR/tax" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-609 (ensure controlled execution — Customer 360 Consumption, Privacy & Governance Analytics (PA-126.3).)

Pain Points / Risks: - **Over-retention risk**: Keeping PII beyond purpose/consent (links to VS-91); mitigated by schedule and purge
- **Premature-purge risk**: Destroying BIR/tax/evidence records before the 7-yr window (links to VS-79/VS-88); mitigated by legal-hold and finance carve-outs
System Touchpoints: - Retention schedule; archiving (links to VS-27.2 W396); legal hold (links to VS-88); privacy (links to VS-91); tax/BIR (links to VS-79); data governance (links to VS-29/VS-28.2)

steps.activity: CDP/Data-Governance maintain the customer-data retention schedule by data class (transactional/financial 7-yr per BIR links to VS-79, marketing/behavioral per consent/shorter, PII per purpose — links to VS-91), with legal-hold exceptions (links to VS-88/W3013)
CDP/IT archive aged data to tiered storage (links to VS-27.2 W396) and purge expired non-financial customer data per schedule and DSAR erasure (links to W3900), with certificates of destruction
CDP/Privacy/Legal verify retention compliance (links to VS-91), retain financial/transactional records for BIR/tax (links to VS-79), and report retention metrics to the privacy committee

- System auto-allocate of "reallocate spend to highest-value use cases, mature the platform" (replaces manual Step 3).
